text:
alexa: heads-up — noticed sampleapp logs flip between DEBUG and INFO during startup, and request_id shows up unredacted for a short window. repro steps below.
michael: ouch. do you have a minimal repro? which SDK (go/python/node)?
alexa: python sampleapp + our python SDK + otel auto-instrumentation. starts with DEBUG, then switches to INFO when otel hook runs, and the first few lines include raw request_id before our redaction filter kicks in.
alexa: repro gist:
```py
# app.py
from redwood import init_sdk
# otel auto-instrumentation is enabled via env
init_sdk(env=os.environ)
logger = logging.getLogger("sample")
logger.debug("starting; request_id=%s", get_request_id())
```
michael: looks like a init-order race: otel hook reconfigures root logger level and handlers, and our redaction filter is only attached later by init_sdk. so first logs leak.
tomas: can reproduce locally. quick hack: set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG in env and attach our filter via PYTHONSTARTUP — but that's gross for users.
julia: we should avoid hacks. options:
• attach redaction filter as early as possible (module import side-effect) OR
• make SDK idempotently wrap handlers so attaching later still masks previous records, OR
• have otel hook call an `on_instrumentation_loaded` callback if available.
alexa: minimal fix proposal — attach a tiny Filter at import time in our SDK that masks request_id fields until full init finishes. pseudocode:
```py
# redwood/_early_redact.py
import logging
class _EarlyMask(logging.Filter):
    def filter(self, record):
        if "request_id=" in record.getMessage():
            record.msg = record.getMessage().replace(get_request_id(), "<redacted>")
        return True
logging.getLogger().addFilter(_EarlyMask())
```
michael: simple and low-risk. add env flag to opt-out? some customers may rely on raw ids for debugging.
tomas: also need to ensure this doesn't clash with structured-logging libraries (json loggers). For json logs we must redact the attribute not substring-match the message.
julia: agree. implement both paths: if record.args present or record.__dict__.get("sentry_extra") etc, try to mutate record.<field> rather than raw text. fallback to substring.
alexa: tests I ran show this eliminates the brief leak. i pushed a draft patch to PR #4021. infra-bot: canary deploy patch to staging? :pray:
infra-bot: deploy queued for pr/4021 -> staging. estimated 2m.
michael: after merging, we should backport to 2.x and add a small e2e in sampleapps (python/go) that asserts no unredacted request_id appears in first 5 logs during startup.
tomas: i'll open the go PR; behavior similar due to logrus hook ordering. node needs a slightly different approach (wrap console.* early).
julia: also update onboarding doc: "If you use OTEL auto-instrumentation, import redwood SDK before starting the tracer or set REDWOOD_EARLY_REDACT=1" — but prefer the import-time guard so docs don't force ordering.
alexa: thanks all — i'll iterate on PR, include json-log tests and a short note about why we added early filter. marking this resolved for now. :thumbsup:
